about_the_game:
Full Throttle Fantasy

Not fast enough? Then come a little closer.

Sexy biker girls tearing through the scorching streets of Miami, kicking up the heat with every rev of the engine — this is your wild ride back to the chaotic thrill of childhood brawls!

A reimagined homage to the classic Road Rash, now spiced with that extra "naughty" kick you didn’t know you needed. This is riding like never before.

Signature Weapons

1. Naughty Weapons: Vibrators, Whips, Chains, Love Eggs, Shock Batons...

2. Sporty Weapons: Baseball Bats, Golf Clubs, Cue Sticks...

3. Melee Weapons: Axes, Steel Pipes, Machetes, Sledgehammers, Chainsaws...

4. Firearms: Pistols, Rifles, Harpoon Guns, Tether Blasters...

5. Legendary Weapons: Heavenly Halberd, Crescent Moon Blade, Silver Dragon Lance...

Each hit triggers a unique reaction — in full voice-over, available in English, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.

You won’t want to stop. And maybe... you can’t.

Open World of Desire & Speed

An expansive city where lust collides with velocity. Over 100 km² of adrenaline-fueled freedom:

  • Bustling downtowns with scorching energy

  • Sensual, sun-drenched beaches

  • Suburban secrets waiting to be uncovered

  • Hazard-packed industrial zones

  • Wild, seductive mountain forests...

Ride motorcycles, race horses, pilot planes, cruise yachts, and enjoy the constant company of your moto girls — every second of this city teases your senses.

Hot-Blooded Biker Babes

  • Rebel delinquent girls

  • Yandere-style idols

  • Emotionless tech engineers

  • Lovable loli airheads

  • Dark queen dominatrixes

  • Cyber rave DJs

  • Lazy pajama cuties

  • Poisonous femme fatales

  • Eastern sword-maidens

  • Tsundere rich girls…

Each one with personality, voice, and a punch.

Iron Beasts of Battle

  • Flame Outlaw – Raw power and fire

  • Neon Pulse – Electric rhythm and light trails

  • Queen’s Ride – Luxury meets punishment

  • Bone Serpent – Dark speed with venom

  • Skysting Ninja – Agile and lethal

  • Azure Beast – Eastern spirit machine

  • Cuddle Cruiser – Adorable but deadly

  • Mecha Hornet – Futuristic sting

  • Bubble Blaster – Cute chaos on wheels

  • Iron Judgement – Justice at full throttle

Each vehicle is deadly, distinct, and absolutely dripping in style.

"Rider Valkyries" is still under development, but we’re racing full throttle with you. Add us to your wishlist — let’s cross that finish line together!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows8
  • Processor: i5-7300HQ
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX2050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Rider Valkyries is a passionate and fantastical open-world motorcycle racing game set in a vibrant anime universe. Amid roaring engines and dancing lights, you'll ride alongside biker girls with unique personalities and irresistible charm.
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese*, Korean*, French, German, Ukrainian, Russian, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Arabic, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
